text: a concubine: Heb. a woman a concubine, or a wife a concubine
four whole months: Or, a year and four months
friendly unto her: Heb. to her heart
until afternoon: Heb. till the day declined
draweth: Heb. is weak | the day groweth to an end: Heb. it is the pitching time of the day | home: Heb. to thy tent
over against Jebus: Heb. to over against Jebus
so vile a thing: Heb. the matter of this folly
